definition: A degraded or corrupted BCI data stream, often caused by damaged neural lace, cheap black-market implants, or deliberate signal jamming. Produces fragmented sensory input, false memories, or emotional static in the user.
origin: Technical slang among BCI repair techs and neural street doctors
usage: Used by wire heads, medtechs, and underworld implant specialists
example: "She keeps flinching at things that aren't there — her lace is throwing cinder feed, probably cracked at the occipital node."
